The presence of a doublet at 1.43 ppm (3H) and a quartet at 5.05 ppm (1H) suggests an ethyl group. The singlet at 2.69 ppm (6H) indicates two equivalent methyl groups, likely attached to a nitrogen or oxygen. The aromatic region (7.13 to 7.90 ppm) suggests a substituted aromatic ring. I will now validate each isomer against this NMR data to find the best match.

I will start by validating the first isomer: 'C1CC2=CNC3=CC=CC(=C23)[C@@H]1CC(=O)O'.
